name: Warm White Launch
summary: One-take consumer-app launch look: warm white with black UI, a lime accent that ripples and floods the frame, an iridescent glow round a composer box, chat bubbles, dark result cards, a route with a running dot, and a soft serif for the name.

palette.use: black UI: text, buttons, dark cards, the outro page, the phone bezel
the composer box, reply bubbles, light cards (proposed)
hairlines, outlined pills, the route's track (proposed)
lime: the ripple, the flood, sent chat bubbles, the key pill
orange: the secondary accent (the running dot, the mark)
AI glow stop 1 (hex proposed; the source names pink)
AI glow stop 5, only inside the glow (proposed hex)

type.emphasis: the key word in a lime pill or a lime bubble

finish.glowOnly: the iridescent glow round the composer (and the phone)

banned: camera moves that reverse, or zooming in and out back to back
any glow other than the composer's
real food, product or brand photos in previews (draw illustrations)

sources.what: a creator's app launch-film prompt on prompt-motion.com (palette, glow, layout sizes, camera rules, beat map, handoffs)
sources.where: https://prompt-motion.com/ultimaxbt-2ddf1e; research notes docs/research/styles/barty-bart-and-prompt-motion.md, section Warm-White Lime Composer Launch
